# Case title

Status: Planned / Designed / Implemented / Validated — select the status supported by evidence.

This case uses a fictional organization and invented requirements. It contains no employer or customer artifacts.

## Overview

Explain the infrastructure problem, business impact, scope, and available evidence in a short paragraph. State what has been completed and what remains proposed.

## Requirements and boundaries

Document functional and non-functional requirements, constraints, assumptions, and exclusions. Give requirements stable identifiers where traceability helps validation.

## Architecture and decisions

Explain the resource model and relevant trust or network boundaries. Add a diagram only when it improves understanding. Link material decisions under `docs/decisions/`.

## Implementation

Describe implemented components, prerequisites, versions, and reproduction steps. Include Terraform or automation only when needed by the case.

## Validation and evidence

Connect each applicable requirement to a check, its execution status, and its evidence. State what local validation can establish and what requires a cloud deployment. Record failures and limitations as well as successes.

## Security, governance, and operations

Describe applicable controls, access responsibilities, logs, and operational procedures. Include backup, recovery, and RTO/RPO only where the workload calls for them.

## Cost and cleanup

Document estimated cost assumptions and sources before deployment. Label synthetic amounts explicitly. Provide cleanup steps, verification of removal, and any residual charges or retained resources.

## Trade-offs and outcome

Summarize the compromises, remaining risks, and outcomes supported by evidence. Separate planned benefits from observed results.
